source.privacy: aggregate-only; row identities and free text excluded

grain.evidenceItems: one evidence item embedded in an evaluation snapshot; the same provider check can appear in multiple snapshots
grain.warning: Evidence-item rates do not estimate rates of unique CI executions.

metricDefinitions.embeddedEvidenceSnapshots: sum of evaluation.evidence array lengths across parseable normalized_json documents
metricDefinitions.unknownCoverage: embedded evidence whose coverage is absent or UNKNOWN
metricDefinitions.zeroEvidence: evaluation snapshots whose evaluation.evidence array is empty
metricDefinitions.withDuplicateEvidenceNames: evaluation snapshots where at least one evidence name occurs more than once
metricDefinitions.withConflictingStatusesForSameName: evaluation snapshots where at least one duplicated evidence name has more than one status

interpretationLimits: Repeated snapshots mean evidence-item percentages are not unique execution rates.
Stored evidence cannot attribute duplicate names to matrices, parallel workflows, retries, or providers.
Aggregate attention counts do not isolate the contribution of any individual attention rule.
The 25 legacy rows have missing normalized JSON, not invalid JSON.
